selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What two ideas does the passage say the truth of Mercifulness shows?
questions.answer: It shows that the Creator is one, and that His oneness appears within the wide unity of creation.

questions.question: How is the truth of Opening described in relation to all beings?
questions.answer: It is presented as bringing out and unfolding the orderly forms of all created things in a way that covers everything.

questions.question: What feature of mercy is emphasized in the care of living creatures?
questions.answer: Mercy cares for all living beings as they enter worldly life and provides what they need in an orderly way.

questions.question: Which group among living beings is given special attention in the passage?
questions.answer: Those who have just newly come into life are especially mentioned.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the delivery of necessities to living beings?
questions.answer: It says their needs are brought to them completely, without any being left out.

questions.question: What does the passage teach by saying mercy forgets none of them?
questions.answer: It teaches that divine care reaches every individual and misses no one.

questions.question: Why is the truth of Mercifulness said to be comprehensive?
questions.answer: Because it extends to all things and all living beings, not just a small part of creation.

questions.question: In this passage, what is the connection between life beginning and mercy?
questions.answer: When living things come into the world, mercy meets them with provision and care from the start.

questions.question: What happens to the traveller at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: He recognizes and witnesses another proof, called the Third Truth, at the Third Stopping-Place.

questions.question: What does the mention of the Third Truth do structurally?
questions.answer: It closes one proof and opens the way to the next stage of reflection.

questions.question: What main claim is made about the truth of Opening?
questions.answer: Its all-encompassing order in forming created things clearly points to divine unity.

questions.question: What part of creation is used as evidence in this passage: lifeless matter, living beings, or human society?
questions.answer: Living beings are used as the main evidence.

questions.question: At what stage of a living being’s existence is mercy especially highlighted?
questions.answer: It is especially highlighted when living beings first come into this world.

questions.question: What does the passage imply about the source of provision for creatures?
questions.answer: Their provision comes through a deliberate mercy that knows and supplies every need.

questions.question: Why is the phrase about forgetting none of them important?
questions.answer: It shows completeness, meaning no creature is neglected or outside divine care.

questions.question: What does simultaneous mercy toward individuals everywhere help prove?
questions.answer: It helps prove both divine unity and divine oneness working throughout creation.

questions.question: How does the passage connect wide coverage and precise care?
questions.answer: It presents mercy as reaching all things broadly while also serving each individual exactly.

questions.question: What is the effect of the final sentence about the traveller?
questions.answer: It marks a transition, showing that after seeing this proof he moves on to witness another truth.

questions.question: Why would this passage strengthen a believer’s trust in Allah’s care?
questions.answer: Because it describes a mercy that reaches every living being with perfect order and no neglect.

questions.question: Summarize the central message of the passage in one sentence.
questions.answer: The passage teaches that the universal and perfectly ordered care given to all living beings proves the oneness of Allah.

questions.question: What comparison is made between the truth of Opening and the truth of Mercifulness?
questions.answer: Both are shown as clear signs of unity because both work everywhere with order and completeness.

questions.question: What does the unfolding of forms show according to the passage?
questions.answer: It shows that creation happens through a single ordered will.

questions.question: What does nurturing all animate beings show according to the passage?
questions.answer: It shows a mercy that embraces all life and points to one caring Lord.

questions.question: How are newborn or newly appearing creatures treated in the argument?
questions.answer: They are presented as strong evidence because they receive exactly what they need right as they begin life.
